action.details: Opens GitHub code search in your default browser with the exact selection safely encoded as the query.
action.exampleOutput: GitHub opens with code results for “NavigationSplitView”.
action.name: Search GitHub
action.privacySummary: The selected text is sent to github.com as part of the URL when you run the action.
action.requirements: Online Actions must be enabled. GitHub may require sign-in for code results.
action.summary: Search GitHub code for the selected text.
